### Timestamp-indexed evidence — H17 / v3

Contact sheet: two columns, six rows, read left to right. Each tile has a small lower-left source label, `H17 / v3 / [time].00 seconds`, and a dark strip below displaying `[time].000 seconds`. No speaker tiles, focus markers, or “ON AIR” indicators are visible.

| Timestamp | Visible content |
|---|---|
| **48.000 seconds** | Teal background; cream “HARBOR” at upper left. Across the middle are three cream rectangular outlines, each containing a cream circle near its upper portion. At right is a separated cream vertical stroke beside a left-open rectangular outline containing a cream right semicircle. Source label: “H17 / v3 / 48.00 seconds”. |
| **49.000 seconds** | Teal background; upper-left “HARBOR”. Three outlined rectangles with cream circles, followed by the separated vertical stroke and left-open outline with a right semicircle, matching the preceding tile. Source label: “H17 / v3 / 49.00 seconds”. |
| **50.000 seconds** | Teal background; upper-left “HARBOR”. Same cream arrangement of three complete rectangle-and-circle forms and a fourth split/open form with a semicircle. Source label: “H17 / v3 / 50.00 seconds”. |
| **51.000 seconds** | Teal background; upper-left “HARBOR”. Same three complete outlined rectangles containing circles, then a detached vertical stroke and left-open outlined form containing a semicircle. Source label: “H17 / v3 / 51.00 seconds”. |
| **52.000 seconds** | Teal background; “HARBOR” upper left. A cream arch connects two thick upright cream posts. Centered beneath the arch: “A NEW PERSPECTIVE”. Near bottom: “CALIBRATION / SECOND”. Two circular lamps above the arch are labelled “L” at left and “R” at right; both are dark navy with pale lettering. Source label: “H17 / v3 / 52.00 seconds”. |
| **53.000 seconds** | Same teal arch-and-post composition and text: “HARBOR”, “A NEW PERSPECTIVE”, “CALIBRATION / SECOND”. The **L lamp is bright yellow**, with dark “L”; the R lamp remains dark navy with pale “R”. Source label: “H17 / v3 / 53.00 seconds”. |
| **54.000 seconds** | Same teal arch-and-post composition and the three text elements. Both L and R circular lamps are dark navy with pale lettering. Source label: “H17 / v3 / 54.00 seconds”. |
| **55.000 seconds** | Same teal arch-and-post composition, “HARBOR”, “A NEW PERSPECTIVE”, and “CALIBRATION / SECOND”. L lamp is dark navy; **R lamp is bright yellow**, with dark “R”. Source label: “H17 / v3 / 55.00 seconds”. |
| **56.000 seconds** | Same teal background, cream arch and upright posts, and unchanged text. Both L and R lamps are dark navy with pale lettering. Source label: “H17 / v3 / 56.00 seconds”. |
| **57.000 seconds** | Same teal arch-and-post composition and unchanged text. Both L and R lamps remain dark navy with pale lettering. Source label: “H17 / v3 / 57.00 seconds”. |
| **58.000 seconds** | Near-black background with pale “TAIL” near the middle, left of the tile’s horizontal center. No arch, lamps, or “HARBOR” text visible. Source label: “H17 / v3 / 58.00 seconds”. |
| **59.000 seconds** | Near-black background with pale “TAIL” in the same position as at 58 seconds. No arch, lamps, or “HARBOR” text visible. Source label: “H17 / v3 / 59.00 seconds”. |
